record.Description: This recall involves Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses. The mattresses are 8 inches thick and were sold in a twin-XL size. They have a white top and white sides with a gray curve pattern. They were sold compressed in a box. The date of manufacture and “Model: BFC8HMBYTX-US” and care instructions are printed on a sewn-in white label located on one side of the mattress.
record.Title: Longjili Trading Recalls Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability
record.ConsumerContact: Longjili Trading by email at Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com.

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com in March 2026 for between $80 and $95.
Longjili Trading (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled mattresses violate the mandatory flammability standard for mattresses, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Longjili Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED,” on the top surface of the mattress and send a photo of the marked mattress to Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

ai.summary: Longjili Trading has recalled about 50 Pamag Pieeoo twin-XL mattresses because they fail to meet mandatory flammability standards. This defect creates a dangerous fire hazard that could result in severe injuries or death.
ai.next_steps: Stop sleeping on the mattress immediately and reach out to Longjili Trading for a full refund. You need to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the top of the mattress, send a photo of the marked product to Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com, and then discard it.
